name: Musica: Piano Note Practice
subtitle: Sight reading for kids
promotionalText: Play the note on your piano. Musica listens and gives feedback. Help your child build a daily practice habit with 20 free notes, helpful hints, and celebrations.
description:
Help your child connect notes on the staff with keys on a real piano. Musica shows a note, listens as they play, and gives feedback with helpful hints and celebrations.

Use an acoustic piano or a digital piano with its speakers on. Musica listens through your iPhone microphone; no MIDI cable is needed. Practice individual notes in short sessions between lessons.

START WITH 20 FREE NOTES A DAY
• One learner profile and treble-clef practice
• A daily goal your child can complete
• Beginner settings and adjustable practice notes
• Note-name and keyboard hints when they need help
• Celebrations for correct answers and completed goals

GROW WITH MUSICA PREMIUM
• Unlimited daily practice
• Profiles for more children
• Bass clef and the full grand staff
• A progress calendar with daily scores and stars
• A record of the notes practiced each day

MADE FOR FAMILY PRACTICE
Choose a goal and note range that suit your child. Place your iPhone near the piano, enable the microphone, and let them practice at their own pace. Musica supports individual-note reading practice alongside piano lessons; it is not a song course or a touchscreen piano.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No accounts. No data collection. Profiles and practice history stay on your device. Microphone audio is processed on-device and is not recorded or transmitted. Purchase screens are behind a parental gate.

Musica Premium is an optional auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription, with a 7-day free trial for eligible subscribers. The price and trial eligibility are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account subscription settings. Family Sharing is supported for eligible subscriptions.

A sounding piano and microphone access are required for practice. You can keep using the free allowance without starting a subscription.

whatsNew:
More room to learn, every day.

• Practice 20 notes a day for free, up from five.
• Free daily goals now stay within your allowance, so you can reach the celebration.
• Enjoy your daily-goal celebration before the practice limit appears.
• Clearer guidance for placing your iPhone and using your piano's speakers.
• Better-spaced requests for feedback after repeated practice milestones.
reviewNotes:
Version 1.1 increases the free allowance to 20 notes per day. Release builds retain all subscription gates. Create a profile and open Practice; after 20 correct notes the daily-goal celebration appears. Reopening Practice after using the allowance shows the free-limit screen and a parental-gated Premium entry point. The Progress tab and adding a second profile also lead to the parental gate and subscription screen.

An acoustic piano or a digital piano with speakers is required. A separate device playing piano sounds near the iPhone microphone can be used for review. The microphone performs on-device note detection only; audio is not recorded or transmitted.

No sign-in is required. Existing monthly and yearly subscription products and prices are unchanged. The free plan does not require subscribing.
